ModMetaData.name: [UI-Overhaul] PrettyUI
ModMetaData.author: Guezzy
ModMetaData.description: Gives RimWorld’s UI a cleaner, more modern, and understated look by adjusting window colors and overall interface tone—without changing gameplay. Compatible with DLCs (Royalty/Ideology/Biotech/Anomaly/Odyssey) and most other mods.
